annotation_independence: Single Codex source annotator; no independent human adjudication. Held-out labels never used to tune, but this is not an externally blinded evaluation. Gate5 cannot be certified PASS.
protocol_deviation: Critical wrong-company evidence guard found by an additional out-of-benchmark English proper-name probe after first heldout run. Fixed without using heldout labels. The38previously viewed test queries are now regression/retest only; no independent heldout certification claimed. Additional word-boundary/negation scope-basis guard regression was repaired before finalv2.5retest; no untouched-heldout claim. Finalv2.6adds generic source-title statement type/unit metadata and explicit statement-conflict checks; source/ontology completion after exposure,not a new blind test. Features are fixed categorical compatibility rules,not fitted from test labels.

paired_family_bootstrap_C4_minus_B2_MRR.scope: Provisional family-cluster resampling, not independent human evidence.

method_notes: Same source scope/top10 across arms;B0/B1/B2 unchanged.
SEC C1 is B0 passthrough;SEC C2/C3/C4 are B2 passthrough, no SEC improvement claim.
Precision and generic numeric unsupported-answer rates not estimable from non-exhaustive retrieval annotations; null, not zero.
Heldout evaluation allowed only after source policy lock. No independent human reviewer;Gate5 remains PARTIAL.
